segments.text: Hello, Marcus. This is Sarah from Elvenline. How can I help?
Hi, Sarah. We need 25 hundred SDM32 controllers for the new mod.
The production run starts in three weeks, so delivery is critical.
Understood. I will check the supplier and send you a made-by-term date.
Good. Price is less important this time, but please do not be late again.
I will also look for an alternative part in case stuck in short.
Perfect. You can reach me on my mobile, Nero66 Nero1234.
